evidenceBoundary: Rendered Rooms browser behavior is exercised against deterministic in-memory host bridge and local HTTP fixtures. Assertions verify exact list reads, room selection state, guest invite exchange and prompt payloads, host prompt/stop/close requests, and clipboard output. No live Core, Rooms sidecar, realtime peer, model provider, or external service is contacted.
